case_name: State of Punjab v Bahadur Singh and Others
facts: The First Respondent was appointed on 9.5.1982 in the post of a Driver on a work charge basis.
He continued to be employed in the said capacity without being regularized.
Respondent No.1 filed C.W.A. No.7389 of 2004 in the Punjab & Haryana High Court seeking regularization of his service.
As per the impugned order, the said writ petition was disposed of in terms of judgment dated 12.8.2003 in C.W.P. No.1287 of 2003.
issues: Whether the appointment of the respondents on a work charge basis is permissible in law.
Whether the decision of the Constitution Bench in Uma Devi (3) 2006 Indlaw SC 125 (supra) applies to this case.
petitioner_arguments: The Government has issued instructions for absorption of the petitioners.
The Government has issued instructions for absorption of the workers who have rendered three years of regular service.
The authorities have adopted a pick and choose policy while regularizing the services of the work-charge employees of the SYL Canal Project.
respondent_arguments: Appointment of the respondents on a work charge basis being permissible in law, the decision of the Constitution Bench would not be applicable.
The matter should be remitted to the High Court.
court_reasoning: The authorities have adopted a pick and choose policy while regularizing the services of the work-charge employees of the SYL Canal Project.
The principle of seniority has been given goodbye.
Unless the appointment is in terms of the relevant rules and after a proper competition among qualified persons, the same would not confer any right on the appointee.
holding: The respondents are directed to regularize the services of the petitioners with all consequential reliefs within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
